# Soak USA ,  Full LLM Content Index

> Soak USA is a directory of hot springs, natural thermal pools, and geothermal soaking spots across the United States.

## About
- Domain: soakusa.net
- Type: Location directory with 359 mapped records
- Coverage: 14 US states with current directory records
- Data: Records may include GPS coordinates, temperature notes, amenities, access information, and safety guidance

## Navigation
- [Home](https://soakusa.net)
- [Browse by State](https://soakusa.net/browse-states)
- [About](https://soakusa.net/about)
- [Contact](https://soakusa.net/contact)
- [Privacy Policy](https://soakusa.net/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://soakusa.net/terms)

## Data limitations
Individual state and location records may be excluded from search indexing until they have structured source support. Soak USA is a planning directory, not a live-conditions service. Verify access, closures, fees, rules, and water conditions with the responsible operator or land manager before traveling.
